column1: # DEFLATE-SHA-MAP.tsv: the pin-deflate-compiler branch's one rewrite before its first push (2026-11-12, the 70th vir head). 158 committed
# build logs (deflate/logs, k5/logs, compiler/logs) carried home paths in the `trace: .> LEAN_PATH=` line a failed saltbuild prints; those
# log blobs were rewritten (home paths to ~/fleet/vir and ~, the form master's logs carry, as at L4-SHA-MAP.tsv). One line per file; no EXIT
# line and no other byte changed. Author dates and subjects are the originals (old, new, author date, subject; oldest first). Prose, bus posts
# and commit bodies from before the rewrite cite column 1 (e.g. the pin a5edcc7, 802918f, bef0697).
